capabilities: Sync multiple IMA knowledge bases into mirrored folder structures
Convert notes and web articles to Markdown with source links preserved
Download images locally and rewrite links to wikilinks
Save PDF/Word/PPT attachments as-is with generated .md stubs
Run scheduled incremental syncs keyed by doc_id and modify_time
extras: One-way sync only (IMA to Obsidian, never writes back); deletions on IMA are kept locally; wiki items use skip-if-exists due to an API limitation; manual installation from release files is described.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Tencent IMA knowledge base content, web clippings, and attachments into the vault as searchable Markdown files.

relations.evidence: All requests go to ima.qq.com exclusively.

requires.name: Tencent IMA account / Open Platform credentials

summary: One-way sync plugin that imports Tencent IMA knowledge bases and notes into Obsidian as Markdown with localized images and frontmatter.
